indicator.subject: Science
indicator.content_standard: B6.1.2.2 Understand mixtures, the types of formation, uses and ways of separating them into their components
indicator.objective: Examine some uses of mixtures in everyday life

skills.description: Identify everyday examples of mixtures (e.g. salt solution, sugar solution, concrete, sand and water, gari and beans).
Name the components of a given mixture.
Describe the daily uses of mixtures (e.g. salt solution for cooking, concrete for building).
Explain why mixtures are useful in everyday life.
Describe how to prepare a simple mixture (e.g. salt solution, concrete).
Classify a mixture according to its use (food, building, medicine, etc.).

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions total — Difficulty 1: 5; Difficulty 2: 7; Difficulty 3: 5; Difficulty 4: 3.
misconceptions: Mixtures are only made in science labs.
Concrete is a single substance, not a mixture.
Salt solution is not a mixture.
Gari and beans is not a mixture.

questions.stem: Which of these is an everyday example of a mixture?
hints: A mixture has two or more substances combined.
questions.explanation: Salt solution is a mixture of salt and water.
questions.misconception: Salt solution is not a mixture.

questions.stem: Which of these is a mixture used for building?
hints: It is used to build houses.
It is made from cement, sand and water.
questions.explanation: Concrete is a mixture used for building.

questions.stem: Name two everyday examples of mixtures.
answer: salt solution and concrete
sugar solution and sand and water
gari and beans, salt solution
salt solution, concrete
hints: One is food, one is for building.
questions.explanation: Everyday mixtures include salt solution, sugar solution, concrete, sand and water, and gari and beans.

questions.stem: A pupil mixes gari and beans in a bowl. What type of mixture is this?
hints: Both gari and beans are solids.
questions.explanation: Gari and beans form a solid-solid mixture because both are solids.
questions.misconception: Gari and beans is not a mixture.

questions.stem: What are the components of a salt solution?
hints: What two things are mixed together?
questions.explanation: A salt solution is made of salt and water.

questions.stem: Name the components of concrete.
answer: cement, sand and water
cement, sand, gravel and water
cement and sand
hints: It is made from cement and other materials.
questions.explanation: Concrete is made from cement, sand, gravel and water.

questions.stem: What are the components of gari and beans?
hints: The mixture is named after its components.
questions.explanation: Gari and beans is a mixture of gari and beans.
questions.misconception: Gari and beans is a single substance.

questions.stem: What is salt solution used for?
hints: Salt solution is used in food.
It is used to add flavour.
questions.explanation: Salt solution is used for cooking and flavouring food.
questions.misconception: Salt solution is not used for anything.

questions.stem: What is concrete used for?
questions.explanation: Concrete is used for building houses, bridges, and other structures.
questions.misconception: Concrete is only used in labs.

questions.stem: State one use of a mixture in everyday life.
answer: salt solution for cooking
concrete for building
sugar solution for drinks
gari and beans for food
hints: Mixtures are used in food and construction.
questions.explanation: Mixtures are used for cooking (salt solution), building (concrete), and food (gari and beans).

questions.stem: Why is concrete useful in building?
options: It is strong and hard when it dries
questions.explanation: Concrete is useful in building because it is strong and hard when it dries.

questions.stem: Why are mixtures useful in everyday life?
options: They combine useful properties of different substances
They are only used in labs
questions.explanation: Mixtures are useful because they combine the properties of different substances to serve a purpose.

questions.stem: Explain why mixtures are useful in everyday life.
answer: they combine different substances to make something useful, like concrete for building
mixtures combine useful properties of substances
they are used in cooking, building and food
hints: Think about salt solution for cooking.
questions.explanation: Mixtures are useful because they combine different substances to make useful products like concrete for building and salt solution for cooking.

questions.stem: A pupil says, 'Mixtures are only made in science laboratories.' What is the best correction?
options: Yes, mixtures are only made in labs
No, mixtures are common in everyday life, such as salt solution and concrete
No, mixtures are only made in factories
hints: Think about salt solution at home.
questions.explanation: Mixtures are common in everyday life, such as salt solution in cooking and concrete in building.

questions.stem: How do you prepare a salt solution?
options: Add salt to water and stir
Add sand to water and stir
Add salt to oil and stir
Add salt to cement and stir
hints: Salt solution is salt and water.
questions.explanation: To prepare a salt solution, add salt to water and stir until it dissolves.
questions.misconception: Salt solution is made with sand.

questions.stem: Describe how to prepare a sugar solution.
answer: add sugar to water and stir until it dissolves
mix sugar with water and stir
put sugar in water and stir
hints: Sugar is a solid, water is a liquid.
questions.explanation: To prepare a sugar solution, add sugar to water and stir until it dissolves.
questions.misconception: Sugar solution is made without water.

questions.stem: In groups, prepare a simple mixture (salt solution or sand and water). Describe the steps you took and state what type of mixture you made.

criteria.description: Stated the type of mixture (solid-liquid or solid-solid)
Named the components of the mixture

hints: Add a solid to a liquid.
questions.explanation: This is a practical task. Your teacher will mark it using the rubric.

questions.stem: Which mixture is used for food?
hints: Which mixture is used in cooking?
questions.explanation: Salt solution is used in food for cooking and flavouring.
questions.misconception: Salt solution is not for food.

questions.stem: Classify concrete according to its use.
hints: Concrete is used to build houses.
questions.explanation: Concrete is a building material used for construction.

questions.stem: Classify salt solution, concrete, and gari and beans according to their uses.
answer: salt solution - food; concrete - building; gari and beans - food
salt solution for food, concrete for building, gari and beans for food
salt solution: food; concrete: building; gari and beans: food
questions.explanation: Salt solution and gari and beans are used for food, while concrete is used for building.
questions.misconception: All mixtures have the same use.
